explication: LIO-SAM is a ROS1 lidar–inertial odometry and mapping package. Its main workflow deskews lidar scans using timed point and IMU data, extracts geometric features, and uses mapping optimization to estimate poses and build a map; a separate, periodically reset IMU factor graph provides high-rate odometry. Mapping also supports GPS factors and loop closure, and the package exposes map saving. The graph reflects documented or excerpted relationships; some ROS topic links to mapping are conventional but not visible in the sampled mapping excerpt, so they are marked unverified.
